name: Imerys S.A.
summary: Imerys S.A. engages in the supply of specialty minerals for various industries across Europe, the Middle East, Africa, Asia Pacific, and America. The company offers performance minerals, such as additives for plastics, paints and coatings, filtration and life sciences, ceramics, and building products; specialty minerals used as processing aids for extreme work conditions, including refractory, foundry, abrasives, and building chemistry; and graphite and carbon minerals for energy transition and mobile energy markets. It also provides minerals, such as andalusite, ball clay, bentonite, calcium carbonate, carbon black, chamotte, diatomite, feldspar, fused alumina, graphite, halloysite, kaolin,…
